BiblicalUsage: Yatstsîyb is the Aramaic word for certain, for fixed and sure. Nebuchadnezzar said he knew of certainty that the Chaldeans sought to gain time, and Daniel told him the dream is certain and its interpretation sure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's word is certain, and the dream of the kingdoms is sure because God gave it.
